name: University of Birmingham
summary: A green campus university at Edgbaston, near central Birmingham; IB offers are set mainly in HL grades, 6,5,5 to 7,6,6, with 32 points overall.

ib.text: Offers are three HL grades plus a minimum of 32 points: 7,6,6 for A*AA courses, 6,6,6 for AAA, 6,6,5 for AAB, 6,5,5 for ABB. Liberal Arts and Natural Sciences set their own IB offers.

programmes.name: Medicine and Surgery
programmes.about: Five years to become a doctor: campus teaching with a weekly clinical-skills day from year 1, including real General Practice, then hospital and community placements in one of the UK's large healthcare regions.
programmes.ib: 6,6,6 at HL with Chemistry and a second science (Biology, Physics or Maths); 32 points minimum. SL must include English, Biology and Maths if not taken at HL.
programmes.selectionNote: UCAT must be sat in the year you apply; interviews go to those invited. The Applying to Medicine site explains the scoring.

flagshipSource.title: Medicine and Surgery MBChB: a new Centre for Anatomy, Surgical and Clinical Skills opening in 2027 (course page)

programmes.name: Physics and Astrophysics
programmes.about: Core physics from entropy to mechanics, plus observational astronomy, in a degree that mixes theory, mathematics, computing and experimental work; accredited by the Institute of Physics.
programmes.ib: 7,6,6 at HL including Maths and Physics, with the 7 in Maths or Physics; 32 points minimum.

needs.note: The page says Mathematics and does not name AA or AI

programmes.selectionNote: Offers rest on the three HL grades; 32 points is only the floor.

flagshipSource.title: Physics and Astronomy: Institute of Physics accredited, in a School with dedicated academic staff (course page)

programmes.name: Sport, Exercise and Health Sciences
programmes.about: How the body responds to exercise and how to raise performance and health: physiology, anatomy, psychology and biochemistry in labs, a first-year Lake District residential, and advanced options such as extreme environments.
programmes.ib: 6,6,6 to 6,5,5 at HL plus 32 points overall, depending on how many preferred science subjects you take (Biology, Chemistry, Maths, PE, Psychology and others).
programmes.selectionNote: Some ABB-equivalent offers go to applicants with several preferred sciences and an exceptional supporting statement.

flagshipSource.title: Sport, Exercise and Health Sciences: custom-built sport sciences building; Lake District residential

notes: Your HL grades carry the offer: 32 points overall is only the floor, so three strong HL subjects matter more than a high total.
Medicine's 2027 course page shows international fees of £33,750 a year for years 1-2 and £53,880 for years 3-5; other course pages still say 'to be confirmed'.
Birmingham also runs a campus in Dubai with its own entry requirements, so check which campus a course page belongs to.
